import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
    b = list(map(int, input[n+1:2*n+1]))

    original_sum = sum(abs(ai - bi) for ai, bi in zip(a, b))
    min_sum = original_sum

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]
            new_sum = sum(abs(ai - bi) for ai, bi in zip(a,b))
            if new_sum < min_sum:
                min_sum = new_sum
            b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]

    print(min_sum)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
